execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"
CREATE TYPE "public"."InvState" AS ENUM ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."ResumeState" AS ENUM ('PENDING', 'FAILED', 'PROCESSED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."Role" AS ENUM ('HR', 'VIEWER', 'ADMIN')
CREATE TYPE "public"."State" AS ENUM ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPELETED')

CREATE TABLE "public"."Interview" (
  "InterviewLink" text,
  "aiSessionId" text,
  "candidateEmail" text NOT NULL,
  "candidateId" int4,
  "compName" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" int4 NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "endedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "skills" text[],
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" "State" NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "videoLink" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Interview_skills_elem_not_null_79c19a4f" CHECK (array_position("skills", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Membership" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "role" "Role" NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Message" (
  "assistMsg" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "intervLink" text,
  "interviewId" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" text,
  "senderId" int4,
  "userMsg" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."OrgInvitation" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" int4 NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "role" "Role" NOT NULL,
  "status" "InvState" NOT NULL,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Organization" (
  "adminId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Report" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "interviewId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Resume" (
  "fileKey" text NOT NULL,
  "fileUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "skills" text[],
  "status" "ResumeState" NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Resume_skills_elem_not_null_79c19a4f" CHECK (array_position("skills", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Session" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currentTenantId" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "refreshToken" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."SubOrg" (
  "adminId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "orgId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
